transcript.text: Hello, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of Harry at XO Tours. Ask whether the restaurant can seat a tour group of 12 people for dinner on Thursday 20 November at 7 pm, and whether a deposit is needed.
Golden Dragon, how can I help you?
Thank you. Could you confirm that for me?
Twelve people on the twentieth at seven. Let me check. Yes, we can do that, two round tables.
Great, thank you. Just to repeat: Twelve people on the twentieth at seven. Let me check. Yes, we can do that, two round tables. That is all I needed.
We ask for a one hundred dollar deposit for groups over ten, and the set menu is thirty-eight per person.
Thank you for your time, goodbye.
